column1: # Targeted formulas for the Java differential (issue #179): inventory rows the repository's own
# test literals touch only lightly. result type<TAB>formula (`\n` is a line break); "*" means float, boolean, string, object.
# Formulas with variables also run under every context profile of build_corpus.py.

column2: var $x as number set if not exists 5;$x*2
var $s as string set if not exists 'dflt';'<'+$s+'>'
var $b as boolean set if not exists true;if($b){1}else{0}
var $x as number set 1;var $y as number set $x+1;$y*10
var $s as string set 'a';var $t as string set $s;if($s==$t){1}else{0}
call twice(21)+call twice($a)\nfloat twice($v as number){$v*2}
call fact(10)\nfloat fact($n as number){if($n<=1){1}else{$n*call fact($n-1)}}
call loop(0)\nfloat loop($n as number){call loop($n+1)}
import org.unlaxer.tinyexpression.Fee#calculate as fee; external returning as number fee($a,1000,0.1)
import org.unlaxer.tinyexpression.Fee#calculate as fee; external returning as number fee(20,1000,0.1,false,'猫')
import org.unlaxer.tinyexpression.Fee#calculate as fee; external returning as number fee(1,2)
import org.unlaxer.tinyexpression.parser.TestSideEffector#getYear as year; external returning as string year('2026/09/24')
import org.unlaxer.tinyexpression.parser.TestSideEffector#salary as salary; external returning as number salary(300,'Dr. X')
import org.unlaxer.tinyexpression.parser.TestSideEffector#booleanToFloatMethod as b2f; external returning as number b2f($b)
